input: Book a slot at the local ceramics kiln

gold.taskTitle: Book a local ceramics kiln slot
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to reserve a firing slot at a local ceramics kiln facility.

questions.title: Which specific kiln or studio are you targeting?
questions.description: Identify the exact kiln facility or ceramics studio the user wants to book.

questions.title: What type of kiln firing do you need?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs a bisque firing, glaze firing, raku, or another specific type.

questions.title: How many pieces do you plan to fire?
questions.description: Understand the volume of work to ensure the right slot size or shelf space is booked.

questions.title: What is your target date or deadline for the firing?
questions.description: Establish when the user needs the kiln slot by, including any hard deadlines.

questions.title: Have you fired at this kiln before?
questions.description: Find out if the user is already registered or familiar with this facility's booking process.

questions.title: Do you need to prep or deliver work before the slot?
questions.description: Clarify if there are drop-off requirements, lead times, or preparation steps before the firing date.

questions.title: What is your budget for the kiln firing session?
questions.description: Understand any cost constraints that may influence which facility or slot type is chosen.
